summary: D010 is the first P0002 draft that passes the internal anthology-candidate threshold: the source/runtime machinery is still disclosed, but the poem body can be read through ruler, staff, held zero, and water rather than through table, proof, or infrastructure explanation.
strengths: The opening scene gives the source pressure a physical object before any technical noun appears.
A tide staff is honest / only while wet is a compact disclosure-image rather than a source paraphrase.
No value came back. / Water did. turns the failed live pull into absence pressure without naming the infrastructure in the body.
Only a held zero, / and water passing / without agreement leaves the datum problem unresolved in the scene rather than closing it as a concept.
residual_risks: Station Datum remains a technical noun and may still feel imported rather than inevitable to some readers.
The poem has not passed an external disclosed reader test.
Quote-search receipts are preliminary candidate hygiene, not publication clearance.
No current/live NOAA water-level value is captured or claimed.
candidate_boundary: Anthology candidate is an internal holding status. It is not evidence_candidate, not admitted, not external validation, and not project-owner acceptance.
next_action: Freeze D010 as the internal candidate; do not draft D011 before hostile disclosed-reader review or a concrete external-test packet.
non_claim: Internal cold review only; candidate status is not admission, external reader evidence, or publication clearance.
